units.name: Department of Industrial Systems Engineering and Product Design
units.evidence: The official EA18 site identifies the department by this full name within Ghent University's Faculty of Engineering and Architecture and lists its Industrial Engineering and Operations Research master's programme. The separate faculty committee and 2026–2027 university catalogue establish the named doctorate; the department page does not itself claim to administer it.

units.name: Department of Business Informatics and Operations Management
units.school: Faculty of Economics and Business Administration
units.evidence: The official Ghent department page names this full department in the business faculty and describes doctoral supervision; its department homepage links Operations Research & Scheduling and Operations and Production Management research groups. No separate business doctorate is inferred from that unit identity.

decisions.reason: The opened EA18 institutional page establishes the full official department title and faculty parent; the imported label represents this unit.

sources.note: Official EA18 department identity and Ghent faculty parent.
Official business faculty department identity and doctoral-supervision statement.
Department homepage lists Operations Research & Scheduling and Operations and Production Management groups.
Current university catalogue lists named IE/OR doctorate and Faculty of Engineering and Architecture.

limitations: Official doctorate is assigned to the Faculty of Engineering and Architecture in the catalogue, not specifically to EA18; no department-to-degree administrative link inferred.
Exact business doctorate remains a separate doctoral-review question.
